newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia RTS shares index hits record high.
newsitem.headline: Russia RTS shares index hits record high.

text.p: The Russian Trading System 24-share equity index rose 6.4 percent to a record close of 279.11 on Tuesday on a record $75.46 million market turnover, the NAUFOR brokers' association said.

Operators said share prices looked ready to rally more, despite a market drop in the afternoon on rumours that President Boris Yeltsin, recovering from a bout of pneumonia, had suffered another health setback.
"All indications show that if Yeltsin is okay the market will continue to rally," said Dan Rapoport, Director of Institutional Equity Sales at CentreInvest Securities.

Yeltsin's press service said it would not comment on market rumours except to say Yeltsin's condition was unchanged from Monday. On Monday press secretary Sergei Yastrzhembsky told a news briefing Yeltsin was leaving hospital.
A number of leading stocks, still the primary target of Western investors allocating new funds to Russian equities, closed up from Monday but off record highs.
Mosenergo ended the day at $1.52, off a record $1.63 set during the day, but up from $1.46 at Monday's close. UES finished at $0.1515, off the day's high of $0.1650 but up from $0.1450 on Monday.
Irkutskenergo rose to $0.233, off $0.252, a new high, but up from Monday's $0.205, fuelled by news that its American Depositary Receipt programme was likely to begin in a few days.
Per Maelstrom, head of research at Brunswick brokerage in Moscow, said Western fund managers were more concerned with allocating funds in the market than avoiding possible corrections.
"Russia has gone from being a market that you could have been fired for being in, to a market that you could be fired for not being in," Maelstrom said.

Rapoport said bears and profit-takers had been looking for bad news and reasons to sell because the bull run, which has seen the RTS index rise almost 50 percent on its pre-Christmas level, seemed unsustainable. The index closed at 186.94 on December 23.
But he said that even some investors with long experience in Russia were buying.
